content.text:
Built **LAST LIGHT: Willow Island**, an original, mobile-friendly survival shooter in `index.html`. It includes a perspective-rendered island, eleven AI rivals, shooting and reloading, scavenged supplies, a shrinking safe zone, a minimap, and touch controls for movement, firing, jumping, and reloading.

Desktop controls and launch instructions are in `README.md`. I checked the game in a browser at a mobile viewport and verified the game script syntax. It uses `requestAnimationFrame` and limits pixel density to help performance; 60 FPS will depend on the device and browser, so it can’t be guaranteed on every phone.
